_description: Dropdown component tokens — option list container + per-context option-row state matrix + dropdown-specific icons and divider. Field interior consumes -input fully (no dropdown-local field tokens). 4-mode universal (TRATON Light + Dark + Scania Light + Scania Dark) on every token per convention-4-mode-universal.
_status: Draft — ready for spec-validator. Designer canvas tasks queued for INTERNAL promotion + Secondary-selected split + tick-icon raw-fill cleanup + Header Text Focus/Typing coverage.

in: Option list container surface — Primary + Secondary contexts (background/primary, background/secondary).
Option-row backgrounds — per-context (Primary/Secondary) × per-state (Default/Hover/Selected). Default at-rest aliases container surface (surface-on-surface).
Option text — default + selected (selected ships value-coincident with default; future-lever).
Dropdown chevron icon (field trailing) — single token, covers Open=False (chevron_down) and Open=True (chevron_up); shape swap, no color change.
Per-option tick icon on Selected variants.
Per-option Nested-type chevron (the `>` indicator on Type=Nested item rows).
Per-option bottom-border divider (stroke on each item-row root).
out: Multi-select pill rendering in field — Scania core (dropdown.tsx) renders comma-separated labels, not pills; tegel-lite same. No chip-style tokens needed.

_crossClusterDependencies.-input (cluster #6): MERGED — field interior fully consumed. See _fieldInteriorAdoption.
_crossClusterDependencies.popover (cluster #16): Naming precedent only (leaf-level background/{variant} for container surface). Dropdown does NOT consume Popover tokens; option list is its own COMPONENT_SET.
_crossClusterDependencies.checkbox (cluster #13): Multiselect option rows render Checkbox INSTANCE. No dropdown-local pill or checkbox-style tokens needed.
_crossClusterDependencies.-focus (helper): Item focus rendered as box-shadow ring using color/foreground/border/accent-focus; not dropdown-local.

_divergence.header-text-focus-typing: Dropdown Header has State=Text Focus + State=Typing variants used in filter mode (field has keyboard focus while text input is active / user actively typing). These states are NOT covered by component/-input today. Spec ships without dropdown-local additions; designer/architecture call needed: extend -input to cover Text Focus / Typing, OR coin dropdown-local field-state tokens. Surfaced at handover.
_divergence.item-selected-canvas-mismatch: Canvas today binds both Primary and Secondary Selected variants to the same INTERNAL/color__wip/UNSORTED/background/surface/300 placeholder. Bridge SCSS values diverge per context on TRATON Light/Dark + Scania Dark. Spec ships per-context-split (item/primary-selected + item/secondary-selected); designer canvas task to (a) promote the INTERNAL placeholder, (b) rebind Secondary Selected variants to the new secondary token.
_divergence.item-tick-icon-raw-fill: Tick icon outer INSTANCE on Selected variants currently has raw #ffffff fill (not bound to any variable). Inner VECTORs (Traton + Scania) are correctly bound to color/icon/strong. Pre-existing canvas drift. Designer handover: clear the outer raw fill (or bind to component/dropdown/icon/item/checkmark-default if a wrapper-level binding is intentional).
_divergence.hover-internal-promotion: TRATON-Light values of component/dropdown/hover and component/dropdown/secondary/hover currently chain through INTERNAL/color__wip/UNSORTED/background/surface/100 (resolves to traton/color/grey/150). Spec ships with the INTERNAL chain replaced by a direct primitive alias; promotion happens at the rename step.

_designerHandover: Rename existing variable component/dropdown/hover → component/dropdown/background/item/primary-hover. Plugin API name-only; IDs + bindings preserved.
Rename existing variable component/dropdown/secondary/hover → component/dropdown/background/item/secondary-hover. Same name-only rename.

Promote INTERNAL/color__wip/UNSORTED/background/surface/300: rename to component/dropdown/background/item/primary-selected. Add new variable component/dropdown/background/item/secondary-selected (4-mode, per-context divergence values per bridge SCSS).

Rebind canvas: Secondary Selected variants on Dropdown/List Item COMPONENT_SET (33822:144546 et al.) from the renamed primary-selected token to the new secondary-selected token. Plugin API source-only writes.
Clear raw #ffffff outer fill on `icon/shared/tick` INSTANCE on Selected variants of Dropdown/List Item. Inner VECTOR bindings on color/icon/strong are correct.
Header State=Text Focus + State=Typing coverage gap — call: extend -input or coin dropdown-local.
Promote TRATON-Light hover chain: drop INTERNAL/color__wip/UNSORTED/background/surface/100 indirection; alias directly to traton/color/grey/150 (or its established semantic equivalent).

variables.name: component/dropdown/background/primary
variables.comment: Option list container — Primary surface. Leaf-level per Popover precedent (component/popover/background/primary).

variables.name: component/dropdown/background/item/primary-default
variables.comment: Item at-rest on Primary container. Surface-on-surface per convention-surface-on-surface — value-coincident with container, real fill paint guarantees click-target geometry.

variables.name: component/dropdown/background/item/secondary-default
variables.comment: Item at-rest on Secondary container. Surface-on-surface.

variables.name: component/dropdown/background/item/primary-hover
variables.comment: Rename from existing component/dropdown/hover (VariableID:14121:114024). Light primitives unwrap INTERNAL/surface/100 indirection. Verify Scania-L primitive against bridge #edeff3 at push (Plugin API getter is blind to Scania modes — UI Variables panel canonical).

variables.name: component/dropdown/background/item/secondary-hover
variables.comment: Rename from existing component/dropdown/secondary/hover (VariableID:14121:114020). Light modes value-coincident with primary-hover (bridge intent); Dark modes step deeper (layer-03) for secondary-context contrast against layer-02 surface.

variables.name: component/dropdown/background/item/primary-selected
variables.comment: Promotion target for INTERNAL/color__wip/UNSORTED/background/surface/300 on Primary Selected variants. Values per bridge SCSS intent. Designer canvas task: rebind Primary Selected variants from INTERNAL placeholder to this token.

variables.name: component/dropdown/background/item/secondary-selected
variables.comment: NEW token — splits Selected per context (canvas today collapses to one INTERNAL token; bridge SCSS encodes per-context divergence on TRATON L/D + Scania D). Designer canvas task: rebind Secondary Selected variants from the promoted primary-selected to this secondary token.

variables.name: component/dropdown/text/item/default
variables.comment: Option text at rest. Canvas-confirmed across all probed variants (Default + Hover + Selected text all bind to color/text/strong).

variables.name: component/dropdown/text/item/selected
variables.comment: Option text when Selected. Value-coincident with default today; ships as separate token to reserve future lever (e.g. selected emphasis treatment).

variables.name: component/dropdown/icon/chevron-default
variables.comment: Field trailing chevron. Open=False renders icon/shared/chevron_down; Open=True renders icon/shared/chevron_up. Color identical across both; one token covers both shapes (canvas-confirmed).

variables.name: component/dropdown/icon/item/checkmark-default
variables.comment: Single-select tick on Selected variants. Inner VECTORs (Traton + Scania) bound to color/icon/strong today. Outer INSTANCE has raw #ffffff fill — pre-existing canvas drift (see _divergence).

variables.name: component/dropdown/icon/item/nested-default
variables.comment: `>` chevron on Type=Nested item rows. Value-coincident with chevron-default today; separate token to express the different intent ("opens sub-menu" vs "field open/close affordance").

variables.name: component/dropdown/border/item/divider-default
variables.comment: Per-option bottom-border. Lives on each item-row's root stroke (canvas-confirmed: variant root stroke bound to color/border/discrete directly today).
